result:
The proposed solution uses the lower middle element as the median of even-sized subsets. The standard median of an even-sized set is the average of the two middle elements, and under that definition the answer changes.

Under the standard definition, the even-subset weight of $a_i$ is $\tfrac12\left(\binom{2024}{i}+\binom{2024}{i-2}\right)$, not $\binom{2024}{i}$. For $n=5$ the coefficients of $P-Q$ are $(-1,\tfrac12,2,\tfrac12,-1)$, so $P-Q=-a_1+\tfrac12a_2+2a_3+\tfrac12a_4-a_5$. Taking $a_1=0$ and $a_2=\dots=a_5=1$ gives $P-Q=2$ with $\max(A)=1$, and the Abel-summation bound shows 2 is the maximum. The proposed formula gives $\binom{4}{2}=6$ for $n=5$, so its claimed constant is not the smallest valid one under the standard definition. Its $n=5$ check is only consistent with the lower-median convention, which the problem does not state.

CONFIDENCE: 4
